Project.name: marktext-modernized
Project.annotation: Port and modernization of Mark Text WYSIWYG Markdown editor. Phase A: Electron 30 + Vue 3 + Vite rebase with 13 community PRs merged, released via Homebrew tap with ad-hoc macOS signing. Phase B: full port to Tauri v2 + Rust backend with ~15 MB footprint, preserving the muya WYSIWYG engine unchanged in the WebView.
Project.keywords: markdown, editor, wysiwyg, electron, tauri, vue3, muya, macos, homebrew, port, modernization

Actors.actor-User: End user editing Markdown documents in the desktop app.
Actors.actor-Developer: Developer building, signing, and releasing the app via GitHub Actions.
Actors.actor-HomebrewUser: macOS user installing via `brew install --cask marktext` from the project tap.
Actors.actor-System: Background processes: file watcher, spell checker, auto-updater.

UC-001.Action: Edits a Markdown document in WYSIWYG mode powered by muya
UC-001.Goal: Seamless Markdown editing with live rendering
UC-001.Preconditions: App is running, file is opened
UC-001.AcceptanceCriteria: Typing, formatting, undo/redo work; block/inline elements render correctly; no regressions vs upstream 0.17.1

UC-002.Action: Toggles between Source Code mode, Split view, and Typewriter mode
UC-002.Goal: Switch editing paradigms without losing content or scroll position
UC-002.AcceptanceCriteria: Mode toggle preserves content byte-identical; cursor position preserved where applicable

UC-003.Action: Exports the current document to HTML or PDF
UC-003.Goal: Produce shareable artifacts from the document
UC-003.AcceptanceCriteria: Exported HTML matches preview rendering; PDF preserves typography and diagrams

UC-004.Action: Searches within file and across folder using ripgrep backend
UC-004.Goal: Find text quickly in large directories
UC-004.AcceptanceCriteria: 10k files search returns first results within 500ms; regex/literal/case-insensitive options work

UC-005.Action: Opens a folder; sidebar shows file tree, updates on external changes
UC-005.Goal: Navigate project files with live sync
UC-005.AcceptanceCriteria: chokidar/notify emits create/modify/delete/rename within 500ms; no stale entries

UC-006.Action: Applies themes (dark/light/sepia) and loads custom CSS
UC-006.AcceptanceCriteria: Theme switch is instantaneous; custom CSS paths persist in preferences

UC-007.Action: Renders Mermaid, Vega-Lite, flowchart, and KaTeX diagrams inline
UC-007.Goal: Visualize diagrams directly in the editor
UC-007.Preconditions: Document contains fenced blocks with recognized languages
UC-007.AcceptanceCriteria: Mermaid v11 features supported (#4025); macOS-specific rendering bug fixed (#4157); no regressions for v10 documents

UC-008.Action: Enables spell checking with multiple languages
UC-008.Goal: Catch typos as the user types
UC-008.AcceptanceCriteria: Suggestions appear in context menu; user can add words to personal dictionary

UC-009.Action: Works with multiple tabs; drags and drops images into the editor
UC-009.Preconditions: Multiple files can be opened; clipboard/DnD allowed
UC-009.AcceptanceCriteria: Tabs persist across restart; image paste transforms to local path (#4150)

UC-010.Action: Toggles Full WYSIWYG mode which hides markdown syntax characters
UC-010.AcceptanceCriteria: Markdown syntax invisible when mode on; no content loss on toggle; live system theme follows macOS appearance

UC-011.Action: Is protected from XSS (CVE-2023-2318, #3621) and from silent shell.openPath() invocations (#4177)
UC-011.Goal: Security posture free of known CVEs; user prompted before external shell invocation
UC-011.Preconditions: Document may contain arbitrary links and HTML
UC-011.AcceptanceCriteria: Injected `script` tags do not execute; opening `file://` or external URLs triggers a confirmation dialog

UC-012.Action: Runs `brew tap xronocode/mark && brew install --cask mark`
UC-012.AcceptanceCriteria: Command completes without sudo; app is installed to /Applications as Mark.app; launches without Gatekeeper error

UC-013.Action: Tags a release; CI builds, ad-hoc signs, and publishes DMG/ZIP artifacts
UC-013.Goal: Notarization-free distribution without paid Apple Developer account
UC-013.AcceptanceCriteria: Release job succeeds on macos-14 (arm64) and macos-13 (x86_64) as blocking; ubuntu-latest and windows-latest run with continue-on-error; ad-hoc signature valid locally.

UC-014.Action: Launches the installed app on macOS arm64 without running `sudo xattr`
UC-014.Preconditions: App installed via brew cask with postflight xattr
UC-014.AcceptanceCriteria: Spotlight → MarkText opens window in under 2s; no Gatekeeper blocking dialog

UC-015.Goal: Lightweight app (target ~15 MB after Phase B)
UC-015.AcceptanceCriteria: Phase A: `du -sh` < 120 MB. Phase B: `du -sh` < 30 MB.

UC-016.Action: Runs `brew upgrade --cask mark` after a new release is tagged
UC-016.Goal: Automatic update path via Homebrew livecheck
UC-016.Preconditions: Cask has livecheck block and GitHub Release exists
UC-016.AcceptanceCriteria: brew detects new version; download+install succeeds; user data preserved

UC-017.Goal: Support portable mode, safe-mode recovery, custom data dir, and debug workflow
UC-017.Preconditions: Binary executable from terminal or via Spotlight shortcut
UC-017.AcceptanceCriteria: Each flag has deterministic effect; --safe disables user prefs/keybindings; --user-data-dir relocates storage root; unknown flag returns error with usage

UC-018.Action: Imports a docx/odt/latex/rst/org/wiki/textile/opml/epub file via File → Import
UC-018.Goal: Convert foreign formats to Markdown using pandoc
UC-018.Preconditions: pandoc is on PATH or MARKTEXT_PANDOC env var points at binary
UC-018.AcceptanceCriteria: File successfully converted to Markdown in new tab; if pandoc missing, user sees actionable notification with install link

UC-019.Action: Triggers Help → Check for Updates; chooses "Download" when update is available
UC-019.Goal: Stay on the latest release without leaving the app
UC-019.Preconditions: Network available; GitHub Releases feed reachable
UC-019.AcceptanceCriteria: Update check shows clear states (checking / available / not-available / error); manual download only (no auto-download); quit-and-install flow works

UC-020.Action: Opens File → Open Recent (up to 12 entries)
UC-020.Preconditions: At least one file opened previously
UC-020.AcceptanceCriteria: List persists across restart; OS integration works (macOS Dock, Windows Jump List); stale paths are skipped silently

UC-021.Action: Triggers macOS screenshot via menu; selection is saved to workspace and inserted into the document
UC-021.AcceptanceCriteria: Selection triggers system capture UI; resulting PNG saved to `dataCenter.screenshotFolderPath`; Markdown `![](relative/path)` inserted at cursor

UC-022.Action: Configures GitHub ImageBed (owner/repo/branch + token via keychain); pastes an image; image uploads and URL replaces the local path
UC-022.Goal: Automatic hosted image upload for Markdown docs
UC-022.Preconditions: GitHub token stored via keytar; network available
UC-022.AcceptanceCriteria: Token never logged or embedded in exports; upload failure shows actionable error; user can switch uploader (none / github / picgo / custom-CLI) without restart

UC-023.Action: Opens a non-UTF-8 file (Shift-JIS, GB2312, Latin-1, UTF-16 BOM, etc.)
UC-023.Goal: Correct rendering of Markdown regardless of original encoding
UC-023.AcceptanceCriteria: BOM detected for UTF-8/UTF-16; CED falls back for BOM-less files; preference `defaultEncoding` accepts 28 codec enum; on save, original encoding preserved unless user changes it

UC-024.Action: Opens a file with mixed or CRLF line endings; saves it unchanged
UC-024.Goal: Preserve line ending style through load → edit → save roundtrip
UC-024.AcceptanceCriteria: LF/CRLF/mixed detected; `trimTrailingNewline` (0-3) respected; `endOfLine` (default/lf/crlf) honored on save; user notified on mixed endings

UC-025.Action: Invokes Command Palette (Cmd+Shift+P) and fuzzy-searches a command; presses Enter to execute
UC-025.Goal: Keyboard-first access to all 65+ commands without menu traversal
UC-025.AcceptanceCriteria: All user-invokable commands searchable; shortcut shown next to command; non-existent command returns empty; dialog closes on Escape

UC-026.Action: Edits a document containing a LaTeX block; app invokes `pandoc` or `texbin` tooling on macOS
UC-026.Goal: Ensure macOS-bundled TeX/LaTeX (`/Library/TeX/texbin`) is findable by subprocesses
UC-026.Preconditions: macOS host; MacTeX/BasicTeX installed by user
UC-026.AcceptanceCriteria: Subprocess PATH includes `/Library/TeX/texbin` automatically on macOS; Linux/Windows unaffected

UC-027.Action: Types Chinese/Japanese/Korean text into muya editor using IME (system input method)
UC-027.Goal: CJK text entry without data loss during composition
UC-027.Preconditions: OS IME active (pinyin, kana, etc.); user mid-composition when keystroke fires
UC-027.AcceptanceCriteria: No keystroke handler mutates block.text between `compositionstart` and `compositionend`; composition proceeds uninterrupted; final composed text inserted correctly at cursor

UC-028.Action: Saves a document containing a table whose tbody rows have fewer cells than header, OR cells starting with `|`
UC-028.Goal: Markdown roundtrip preserves content without corruption
UC-028.Preconditions: Table already in document via paste/edit
UC-028.AcceptanceCriteria: Cells starting with `|` export as `\|` (properly escaped); irregular rows pad to header length with empty cells; no literal "undefined" strings in output

ResolvedDecisions.decision-product-name: Mark (renamed from "MarkText"; bundle path becomes /Applications/Mark.app; bundle id com.xronocode.mark)
ResolvedDecisions.decision-tap-repo: https://github.com/xronocode/homebrew-mark (users invoke: `brew tap xronocode/mark` then `brew install --cask mark`)
ResolvedDecisions.decision-signing: ad-hoc only (no Apple Developer ID); cask postflight uses `xattr -cr`.
ResolvedDecisions.decision-os-scope: macOS arm64 + x86_64 are blocking CI jobs; ubuntu-latest and windows-latest run with continue-on-error so they never block a release.
ResolvedDecisions.decision-mermaid: v11 only, no legacy mode. Breaking changes documented in v1.0 CHANGELOG.

NonGoals.item-1: No paid Apple Developer notarization in Phase A or B (explicitly ad-hoc only).
NonGoals.item-2: No rewrite of muya engine — it ports to WebView unchanged.
NonGoals.item-3: No feature additions beyond the approved 4 community feature PRs (#4145, #4025, #4070, #4150).
NonGoals.item-4: No Windows/Linux blocking gates in Phase A; those platforms are best-effort (continue-on-error in CI).
NonGoals.item-5: No telemetry or analytics added to the app.
NonGoals.item-6: No re-engagement with upstream marktext/marktext maintainers — this is an independent fork.
NonGoals.item-7: No Mermaid v10 legacy rendering path.
NonGoals.item-8: No Windows ia32 target in CI matrix (upstream builds it; we drop).
NonGoals.item-9: No `build:muya` / `release:muya` npm publish workflow (upstream scoped `@marktext/muya` package not maintained; we keep muya vendored).
NonGoals.item-10: No implementation of `Export/Import Preferences` UI (stubbed in upstream; remains stubbed in v1.0). Revisit after v2.0.
NonGoals.item-11: No macOS-only Tweet share dialog (`src/renderer/components/tweet`) — dropped feature.
NonGoals.item-12: No workspace-level preference overrides (no `.marktext/` folder scanning) — revisit in v2.x.
NonGoals.item-13: No implementation of multi-cursor, collaborative editing, change-tracking, or sort-tables-by-column (muya limitations acknowledged).
NonGoals.item-14: No attempt to preserve Electron auto-update continuity from upstream `com.github.marktext.marktext` — new fork starts clean feed under `com.xronocode.mark`.

Constraints.constraint-1: macOS arm64 must launch without `sudo xattr` or Apple Developer signature.
Constraints.constraint-2: muya source under src/muya/ must remain editable but logically unchanged during port (bugfixes only).
Constraints.constraint-3: User preferences and workspace state must migrate across Phase A → Phase B without data loss.
Constraints.constraint-4: CommonMark + GFM regression specs (test/specs/) must stay green across all merges.
Constraints.constraint-5: No breaking changes to document file format.

Risks.risk-1: PR #4001 may conflict heavily with bugfix PRs merged first; mitigation is merge-order discipline.
Risks.risk-2: Native Electron modules (keytar, chokidar, fontmanager-redux, native-keymap, vscode-ripgrep, @hfelix/electron-localshortcut) may not rebuild for Electron 30 ABI.
Risks.risk-3: muya may be measurably slower in WKWebView than in Chromium on large (>10 MB) documents; no DOM virtualization.
Risks.risk-4: Spellcheck strategy revised after audit: upstream uses Chromium session + hunspell, NOT NSSpellChecker. Use Tauri WebView `spellcheck="true"` + tauri-plugin-spellcheck instead of objc2 FFI.
Risks.risk-5: Ad-hoc signing may still trigger Gatekeeper on strict corporate macOS policies; documented fallback is xattr.
Risks.risk-6: Mermaid v10→v11 upgrade may break users' existing diagrams; mitigation is changelog + optional legacy mode.
Risks.risk-7: Prefs migration is 4-store (preferences.json + dataCenter.json + keybindings.json + recently-used-documents.json + keytar), not a single file; each must be migrated with ajv schema preservation.
Risks.risk-12: Renderer directly imports Node core modules (`fs`, `path`, `child_process.spawn`, `crypto`, `Buffer`, `os.tmpdir`) in 10+ files; `@electron/remote` used in 6 files. This blocks contextIsolation. PR #4001 does NOT address this. Requires a dedicated Phase-A1.5 to move Node APIs out of renderer before toolchain migration.
Risks.risk-13: `dragula` (used for tab drag-drop reorder) has poor Vue 3 reactivity interaction; may break at PR #4001 merge; fallback to vue-draggable-plus or sortable.js.
Risks.risk-14: `fontmanager-redux` is loaded via `require('fontmanager-redux')` inside a `.vue` file; breaks contextIsolation. Must move enumeration to main/backend.
Risks.risk-15: Upstream uses dynamic IPC channel IDs (`mt::response-of-image-path-${id}`) — Tauri events are static; M-013 needs a dispatcher with per-request correlation keys.
Risks.risk-16: 59 `ipcRenderer.on()` listeners across renderer with 0 `removeListener()` calls — memory leak pattern; Phase-A1.5 must introduce listener-cleanup convention that Vue 3 migration preserves.
Risks.risk-17: Five identified race conditions in existing code: rapid window-close + pending save, settings changed during prefs dialog, file rename + external change, clipboard read in headless mode, sendSync timeout.
Risks.risk-18: KaTeX `\href` and `\input` commands NOT explicitly filtered; if user pastes `$\href{javascript:...}{x}$`, output may leak dangerous URL — DOMPurify catches HTML but not LaTeX-to-HTML edge cases.
Risks.risk-19: Vega-Embed receives user-provided specs; JS expressions in transforms are not restricted; malicious Vega spec could execute JS in WebView.
Risks.risk-20: macOS subprocess PATH patching (`/Library/TeX/texbin`) is hardcoded in main process; Tauri subprocess commands must replicate this or LaTeX tooling will not resolve.
Risks.risk-21: `ipcRenderer.sendSync('mt::ask-for-image-path')` at renderer/store/editor.js:1193 blocks renderer; deprecated in Electron 30. Must be rewritten to invoke() in Phase-A1.5.
Risks.risk-22: Upstream DOMPurify configs exist in two places (`/src/renderer/util/dompurify.js` + `/src/muya/lib/utils/dompurify.js`) with subtly different rule sets (PREVIEW vs EXPORT). Phase-B port must keep BOTH; V-M-010 fixture must exercise both paths.
Risks.risk-23: Upstream `isChildOfDirectory()` path sandbox does NOT lowercase paths on Windows — sandbox bypass on case-insensitive FS. Needs Windows-aware normalization.
Risks.risk-24: muya has 47 public methods + 26 events + 3 host hooks (`window.DIRNAME`, `imageAction()`, `clipboardFilePath()`). Losing any in M-011/M-013 breaks renderer silently. Needs API-snapshot regression test.
Risks.risk-25: Upstream ships `resources/hunspell_dictionaries/` with bundled hunspell dict files; Phase-A must not drop these, else spellcheck loses OSS languages on Linux/Windows.
Risks.risk-26: IPC surface is 146 channels (not ~80 initial estimate); M-013 bridge has proportionally larger contract snapshot and correspondingly higher chance of drift.
Risks.risk-27: Upstream muya has NO compositionstart lock across 6 keystroke handlers (enter/backspace/tab/arrow/delete/input). Typing CJK (Chinese/Japanese/Korean) mid-composition → keystroke handlers mutate block.text between compositionstart and compositionend → data corruption. Affects ~30% of world users. Must add lock in Phase-A1.5.
Risks.risk-28: Upstream table pipe-escape bug (`exportMarkdown.js:300`): cells starting with `|` export as `||foo` breaking column separator → markdown save roundtrip data corruption.
Risks.risk-29: Upstream irregular-table export bug (`exportMarkdown.js:303-306`): tbody rows shorter than header produce literal "undefined" string in exported markdown.
Risks.risk-30: Upstream autoSave preference race: auto-save timer fires after user toggles autoSave OFF (`editor.js:1002` does not re-check pref at fire time).
Risks.risk-31: Upstream nested list items created without `listType` key/value (`paragraphCtrl.js:116` HIGH TODO) — nested list mutations silently fail.
Risks.risk-32: Upstream parser uses `insertAdjacentHTML` in `partialRender` (`render/index.js:213`) — safe today because vnode-derived but architectural XSS footgun if code changes.
Risks.risk-33: Upstream parser: reference definition hrefs NOT sanitized at parse time; `[x][ref]` with `[ref]: javascript:...` in reference def stored raw, only sanitized at link render via sanitizeHyperlink.
Risks.risk-34: Upstream parser: NO recursion depth limit for blockquote / list / footnote — deeply nested document (e.g., `[^[^[^...]]]`) → stack overflow.
Risks.risk-35: Upstream UI plugin layer: ZERO ARIA roles, i18n, list virtualization, touch events across all 13 plugins; Unsplash API key exposed if bundled in `muya.options.unsplashAccessKey`. Accept as v1.0 tech debt, document in release notes.
Risks.risk-36: Upstream menu: 0/22 File menu items use `COMMANDS.*` constants (all action-function based); Tauri port of M-009 requires command-id refactoring for File/View/Window/Theme/Help groups (86/128 items need migration).
Risks.risk-37: Tauri lacks native Electron roles: `services`, `recentdocuments`, "Bring All to Front" — must stub or self-implement via objc2 NSDocumentController (macOS) / custom logic (Windows/Linux).

OpenQuestions.question-2: Product renamed to "Mark" (bundle Mark.app, repo name `mark`).
OpenQuestions.question-3: No Apple Developer ID; ad-hoc only; cask postflight `xattr -cr`.
OpenQuestions.question-4: macOS arm64/x86_64 blocking; Linux/Windows allow-failure in CI.
OpenQuestions.question-5: Mermaid v11 only; breaking changes in CHANGELOG.
